name: NotebookLM
description: AI, Research and Media-native: Google's source-grounded AI research notebook (renamed Gemini Notebook in July 2026) for document Q&A, summaries and audio overviews.
access_notes: No public consumer API exists. Programmatic access is only via the Gemini Notebook Enterprise (formerly NotebookLM Enterprise) API on Google Cloud (google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha, served through *-discoveryengine.googleapis.com), which requires a Google Cloud project plus a Gemini Enterprise or Gemini Education Premium license and admin setup. Standard Google Cloud auth: OAuth bearer tokens (gcloud auth print-access-token), discoveryengine OAuth scopes and IAM permissions; service accounts are the standard server-side pattern.
mcp_notes: No official Google MCP server for NotebookLM found in Google Cloud or NotebookLM docs. Community open-source projects (e.g. notebooklm-mcp-cli mentioned in third-party blogs) exist but are unofficial and unverified. No Composio toolkit (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/notebooklm.md returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: API is v1alpha and covers notebook CRUD, source management, sharing and audio-overview generation for the Enterprise product only; the consumer NotebookLM app (notebooklm.google) has no API. Searches tried for MCP: 'NotebookLM MCP server official', Composio toolkit slugs notebooklm. Webhooks: no eventing/webhook docs found for the notebooklm.v1alpha surface.

evidence.note: Official Gemini Notebook Enterprise API docs: notebooks.create/get/listRecentlyViewed/batchDelete/share via curl with 'Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)'.
RPC reference (google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha): requires OAuth scopes cloud-platform/discoveryengine.readwrite and discoveryengine.notebooks.* IAM permissions.
Source management API: notebooks.sources.batchCreate, uploadFile, get on discoveryengine.googleapis.com.
'NotebookLM is now Gemini Notebook as of July 2026' — same source-grounded research product.
Third-party lead corroborating no public consumer API; enterprise API needs a Google Cloud project and Gemini Enterprise/Education Premium license (matches official docs).
